protocol:
1. Arrange the E-Gel EX Invitrogen 1% agarose gel cassette, E-Gel Power Snap instrument, adjustable micropipette, ice bucket with labeled microcentrifuge tubes, tube rack, and pipette-tip box on the bench.

2. Aspirate liquid with an adjustable micropipette from a tube in the blue tube rack.

3. Remove a labeled microcentrifuge tube from the wet ice and open its cap.

4. Dispense the pipetted liquid into the open microcentrifuge tube while holding the tube above the bench.

5. Return the labeled microcentrifuge tube to the wet ice to keep the sample cold.

6. Repeat the pipetting step with additional labeled microcentrifuge tubes from the wet ice.

7. Open a prepared microcentrifuge tube and aspirate the prepared sample with the adjustable micropipette.

8. Load the prepared sample into a well of the E-Gel EX 1% agarose gel cassette using the micropipette.

9. Place the micropipette on the bench after loading the gel.

10. Open the orange lid of the E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

11. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette into the E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

12. Close the E-Gel Power Snap lid over the gel cassette.

13. Use the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen to select a run program and start electrophoresis with a 10:00 min run time.

14. Allow the E-Gel Power Snap run to proceed; the touchscreen displays the countdown timer.
